get.description:
All assignable roles (with their default permissions) and every permission slug.
Used by the user-management form to render role/permission pickers.

*Requires permission: `manage:users`*  
*Superadmin bypasses all permission checks.*

Staff with `manage:bookings` see everything; others (Business Partners) only bookings in units they own.
Guest `email`/`phone`, `channel_confirmation_code` and `sync.beds24_booking_id`/`sync.error` are `null`
unless the caller has `manage:bookings`. Use `from`/`to` for the calendar window (overlap semantics).

*Requires any one of these permissions: `view:bookings`, `manage:bookings`*  
*Superadmin bypasses all permission checks.*

post.description:
Link an existing guest (`guest_id`) or create/match one inline (`guest`, deduplicated by email then phone).
`check_in`/`check_out` accept a date (`YYYY-MM-DD`, property default times applied) or a wall-clock
datetime in the property's timezone. `direct` bookings are queued for push to Beds24 (`sync.status = pending`).

Business-rule failures return `422` with `code` = `booking_overlap` (includes `conflict`) or `invalid_stay`.

*Requires permission: `manage:bookings`*  
*Superadmin bypasses all permission checks.*

get.description:
`404` when the caller cannot see the booking's unit.

*Requires any one of these permissions: `view:bookings`, `manage:bookings`*  
*Superadmin bypasses all permission checks.*

put.description:
Bookings imported from an OTA are channel-managed: editing `unit_id`, `check_in`, `check_out`, `status`
or `total_price` returns `422` with `code = ota_booking_locked`. Changing a direct booking re-queues the Beds24 sync.

*Requires permission: `manage:bookings`*  
*Superadmin bypasses all permission checks.*

delete.description:
Sets status to `canceled` (idempotent). OTA bookings must be cancelled on the channel
(`422`, `code = ota_cancellation_not_allowed`).

*Requires permission: `manage:bookings`*  
*Superadmin bypasses all permission checks.*

get.description: Returns the Google consent-screen URL. The SPA should navigate the browser to `url`.

Exchanges the Google `code` for a profile and signs in **only** pre-provisioned users
(created by a Superadmin). Any previous Sanctum tokens for the user are revoked and a
new Bearer token is returned. Responds `403` when the email is not whitelisted and `422`
when Google rejects the code.
get.summary: Complete Google OAuth and issue a token

get.description:
Two response tiers: callers with `manage:guests` get contact data, tag, notes, stats and violations;
read-only callers (`view:bookings`, i.e. Business Partners) get identity basics only, limited to guests
who stayed in their units. The `tag` filter is ignored for read-only callers.

*Requires any one of these permissions: `manage:guests`, `view:bookings`*  
*Superadmin bypasses all permission checks.*

post.description:
Creates the account so the person can sign in with Google. Passwords are rejected (`422`).
Only a Superadmin may grant the `Superadmin` role or the `manage:users` permission (`403` otherwise);
non-Superadmins can only grant permissions they hold themselves.

*Requires permission: `manage:users`*  
*Superadmin bypasses all permission checks.*

put.description:
Change name, email, role and/or the direct permission overrides (`permissions` replaces the full override set).
Users cannot change their own role or overrides (`422`). Only a Superadmin may modify a Superadmin (`403`).

*Requires permission: `manage:users`*  
*Superadmin bypasses all permission checks.*

delete.description:
Revokes all of the user's tokens and deletes the account. You cannot delete yourself (`422`).

*Requires permission: `manage:users`*  
*Superadmin bypasses all permission checks.*
